implementation_plan.overview: Implement image preview viewer feature enabling users to open PNG, JPG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, SVG, BMP, ICO files in dedicated tabs with zoom, pan, and full-screen capabilities. Follows existing DiagramViewer patterns for zoom/pan logic while using local state management (no store needed since tabs are independent).

key_scenarios: isImageFile correctly identifies all supported formats
formatFileSize formats bytes to KB/MB correctly
ImageViewerPanel shows error state on load failure
Mouse wheel zooms centered on cursor
Focus is trapped in full-screen mode
Multiple image tabs have independent state
Metadata displays correct dimensions, size, format

risks.mitigation: Use native browser image scaling; consider lazy loading or thumbnail generation for very large files

risks.risk: SVG files with embedded scripts pose security risk
risks.mitigation: Render SVG via tag which prevents script execution; CSP also blocks inline scripts
Use data: URLs by reading files as base64 in main process
Browser handles natively; no special handling needed

verification_criteria: All supported image formats (PNG, JPG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, SVG, BMP, ICO) open correctly in tabs
Zoom buttons (+/-) change zoom to next/prev discrete level
Mouse wheel zooms centered on cursor position
Click-drag pans image when zoomed beyond container
Arrow keys pan image when zoomed
Fit button scales image to fit container with aspect ratio preserved
Full-screen modal opens with toolbar at bottom
Focus is trapped within full-screen modal
Metadata displays dimensions, file size, and format correctly
Loading spinner shows while image loads
Error message displays for invalid/corrupted images
Multiple image tabs maintain independent zoom/pan state
Tab closes without save confirmation dialog
Panel resize recalculates fit scale automatically
